verdict.rationale: CrewAI ships an official CLI (installed via `uv tool install crewai`) documented to create, train, test, and run crews & flows, with dedicated commands like `crewai test`, confirmed by both docs and a live probe of the docs page. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of the CLI itself (community evidence covers the framework broadly, not CLI usage specifically) and no changelog/version history showing CLI maturity over time.
